title: Layan Green Park Phase 2
shortDescription: Layan Green Park Phase 2 is a seven-storey eco-oriented condominium in Cherngtalay, Thalang, Phuket, close to Layan Beach.
description: Layan Green Park Phase 2 is a seven-storey eco-oriented condominium in Cherngtalay, Thalang, Phuket, close to Layan Beach. It comprises five buildings with 377 units, ranging from studios to three-bedroom units and duplexes, some with private pools. The project advertises EDGE Advanced green certification and extensive resort-style facilities.
